interpretation.plain_speak: The simple resource law holds only while pressure is effectively static. Once every arm gets an extra mid-window hit, two schedules with the same reachable action capacity can produce different failure counts. Timing relative to the hazard transition now matters.
interpretation.north_star_question: Refines fixed-resource correction from a one-number capacity law into a joint capacity-and-hazard-timing problem.
interpretation.next_stage: sweep fixed burst timing across the six global rounds to localize when the reachability collapse first breaks
